note: Summaries are original, condensed references. Consult SRD 5.2.1 for complete rules text.

Darkness.meta: Action • 60 ft. • Concentration, up to 10 minutes
Darkness.summary: Magical darkness fills a 15-foot-radius sphere. Darkvision cannot see through it, and nonmagical light cannot illuminate it.

Blight.summary: One creature makes a Constitution save, taking 8d8 necrotic damage on a failure or half on a success. Plants automatically fail.

Eldritch Blast.summary: Make a ranged spell attack. On a hit, the target takes 1d10 force damage. The spell creates additional beams at higher character levels.

Hellish Rebuke.summary: When a creature you can see damages you, it makes a Dexterity save, taking 2d10 fire damage on a failure or half on a success.

Burning Hands.summary: Creatures in the cone make a Dexterity save, taking 3d6 fire damage on a failure or half on a success.

Mage Hand.summary: Create a spectral hand that can manipulate an object, open an unlocked container, stow or retrieve an item, or pour out a vial.

Misty Step.summary: Teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.

Hold Person.meta: Action • 60 ft. • Concentration, up to 1 minute
Hold Person.summary: A Humanoid makes a Wisdom save or becomes Paralyzed. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns.

Mage Armor.summary: A willing unarmored creature has a base Armor Class of 13 plus its Dexterity modifier for the duration.

Ray of Frost.summary: Make a ranged spell attack. On a hit, the target takes 1d8 cold damage and its Speed is reduced by 10 feet until your next turn.

Acid Splash.summary: An acidic bubble bursts in a 5-foot-radius sphere. Creatures there make a Dexterity save or take 1d6 acid damage.

Dancing Lights.meta: Action • 120 ft. • Concentration, up to 1 minute
Dancing Lights.summary: Create up to four hovering lights. Each sheds dim light in a 10-foot radius, and you can move them with a Bonus Action.

Shatter.summary: A 10-foot-radius sphere erupts with sound. Creatures make a Constitution save, taking 3d8 thunder damage on a failure or half on a success.

Lightning Bolt.summary: Creatures in a 100-foot-long, 5-foot-wide line make a Dexterity save, taking 8d6 lightning damage on a failure or half on a success.

Bless.meta: Action • 30 ft. • Concentration, up to 1 minute
Bless.summary: Up to three creatures add 1d4 to attack rolls and saving throws for the duration.

Friends.meta: Action • 10 ft. • Concentration, up to 1 minute
Friends.summary: One visible Humanoid makes a Wisdom save or is Charmed for the duration. The spell ends early if you damage it.

Death Ward.summary: The first time the target would drop to 0 Hit Points, it drops to 1 instead. The spell can also negate one instant-death effect.

Sacred Flame.summary: One creature makes a Dexterity save or takes 1d8 radiant damage. The target gains no benefit from cover for this save.

Fire Bolt.summary: Make a ranged spell attack. On a hit, the target takes 1d10 fire damage, and an unattended flammable object may ignite.

Charm Person.summary: A Humanoid makes a Wisdom save or is Charmed by you. It has Advantage on the save if you or your allies are fighting it.

Dimension Door.summary: Teleport yourself, and optionally one willing creature, to a destination you describe within range.

Invisibility.meta: Action • Touch • Concentration, up to 1 hour
Invisibility.summary: A willing creature becomes Invisible. The spell ends early after the target makes an attack roll, deals damage, or casts a spell.

Thunderwave.summary: Creatures in the cube make a Constitution save, taking 2d8 thunder damage and being pushed 10 feet on a failure.

Heroism.meta: Action • Touch • Concentration, up to 1 minute
Heroism.summary: A willing creature is immune to the Frightened condition and gains temporary Hit Points at the start of each of its turns.

Bestow Curse.meta: Action • Touch • Concentration, up to 1 minute
Bestow Curse.summary: A creature makes a Wisdom save or suffers one curse effect you choose, such as Disadvantage with one ability or attacks against you.

Suggestion.meta: Action • 30 ft. • Concentration, up to 8 hours
Suggestion.summary: Magically suggest a reasonable course of activity to one creature that can understand you. A Wisdom save negates the effect.

Hideous Laughter.meta: Action • 30 ft. • Concentration, up to 1 minute
Hideous Laughter.summary: A creature makes a Wisdom save or falls Prone and becomes Incapacitated. It repeats the save when damaged and at the end of its turns.

Spare the Dying.summary: Choose a living creature at 0 Hit Points. It becomes Stable. The range increases at higher character levels.

Mass Healing Word.summary: Up to six creatures regain Hit Points equal to 2d4 plus your spellcasting ability modifier.

Lesser Restoration.summary: End one disease or one of these conditions on the target: Blinded, Deafened, Paralyzed, or Poisoned.

Guidance.meta: Action • Touch • Concentration, up to 1 minute
Guidance.summary: A willing creature can add 1d4 to one ability check of its choice before the spell ends.

Guiding Bolt.summary: Make a ranged spell attack. On a hit, the target takes radiant damage, and the next attack roll against it has Advantage.

Cure Wounds.summary: A creature regains Hit Points equal to 2d8 plus your spellcasting ability modifier.

Gust of Wind.meta: Action • Self (60-foot line) • Concentration, up to 1 minute
Gust of Wind.summary: A strong wind fills a 60-foot-long, 10-foot-wide line, pushing creatures that fail a Strength save and hindering movement toward you.

Flaming Sphere.meta: Action • 60 ft. • Concentration, up to 1 minute
Flaming Sphere.summary: Create a 5-foot sphere of fire. Nearby creatures make Dexterity saves against fire damage, and you can move the sphere with a Bonus Action.

Find Traps.summary: Sense whether a deliberately created trap is present within range and line of sight, and learn the general nature of its danger.

Thorn Whip.summary: Make a melee spell attack against a creature in range. On a hit, it takes 1d6 piercing damage and can be pulled up to 10 feet toward you.

Poison Spray.summary: One creature makes a Constitution save or takes 1d12 poison damage.

Vampiric Touch.meta: Action • Self • Concentration, up to 1 minute
Vampiric Touch.summary: Make a melee spell attack that deals 3d6 necrotic damage and restores Hit Points to you equal to half the damage dealt.

Animate Dead.summary: Animate a corpse or pile of bones as a Zombie or Skeleton. The spell controls it for 24 hours and provides command rules.

Phantasmal Killer.meta: Action • 120 ft. • Concentration, up to 1 minute
Phantasmal Killer.summary: A creature makes a Wisdom save or becomes Frightened and takes psychic damage while the spell continues.

Zombie.summary: Slam: +3 to hit, 5 (1d8 + 1) bludgeoning. Undead Fortitude can leave it at 1 HP when damage would reduce it to 0, except against radiant damage or a critical hit.

Skeleton.summary: Shortsword or Shortbow: +5 to hit, 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing. Vulnerable to bludgeoning; immune to poison damage and the Exhaustion and Poisoned conditions.

Spider.meta: AC 12 • HP 1 • Speed 20 ft., Climb 20 ft. • CR 0
Spider.summary: Bite: +4 to hit, 1 piercing plus 2 (1d4) poison. Spider Climb and Web Walker.

Giant Wolf Spider.meta: AC 13 • HP 11 (2d8 + 2) • Speed 40 ft., Climb 40 ft. • CR 1/4
Giant Wolf Spider.summary: Bite: +5 to hit, 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing plus 5 (2d4) poison. Spider Climb.

Giant Spider.meta: AC 14 • HP 26 (4d10 + 4) • Speed 30 ft., Climb 30 ft. • CR 1
Giant Spider.summary: Bite: +5 to hit, 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing plus 7 (2d6) poison. Web (Recharge 5–6) can Restrain a target on a failed DC 13 Dexterity save.

Swarm of Insects.type: Medium Swarm of Tiny Beasts, Unaligned
Swarm of Insects.meta: AC 11 • HP 19 (3d8 + 6) • Speed 20 ft., Climb or Fly 20 ft. • CR 1/2
Swarm of Insects.summary: Bites: +3 to hit, 6 (2d4 + 1) poison, or 3 (1d4 + 1) while Bloodied. The swarm resists bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage and has standard swarm immunities.

Deflect Attacks.summary: Use the SRD Monk feature to reduce damage from an attack. At higher Monk levels, the feature can redirect some attacks by spending Focus Points.

Flurry of Blows.summary: Make two Unarmed Strikes as a Bonus Action, following the SRD Monk feature.

Grapple.meta: Attack action • Strength or Dexterity save
Grapple.summary: Use an Unarmed Strike to impose the Grappled condition. The target uses the save and escape rules in the SRD Rules Glossary.

Stunning Strike.meta: Once per turn after a hit • Spend 1 Focus Point
Stunning Strike.summary: Force the target to make a Constitution save. On a failure, it has the Stunned condition until the start of your next turn.

Open Hand Technique.type: Warrior of the Open Hand feature
Open Hand Technique.summary: Choose an Open Hand effect from the SRD subclass, such as preventing Opportunity Attacks, pushing the target, or knocking it Prone.

Patient Defense.summary: Take the Disengage and Dodge actions as a Bonus Action, following the SRD Monk feature.

Step of the Wind.summary: Take the Dash action as a Bonus Action, and your jump distance is doubled for the turn. The SRD feature offers additional movement when Focus is spent.

Empowered Strikes.summary: Your Unarmed Strikes can deal Force damage instead of their normal damage type, following the SRD Monk feature.

Fleet Step.type: Warrior of the Open Hand feature
Fleet Step.summary: Use Step of the Wind when you take another Bonus Action, following the SRD Open Hand subclass feature.

Daltu.meta: AC 14 • HP 24 • Speed 30 ft. • PB +2 • Spell DC 13 • Spell attack +5
Daltu.summary: Example ability scores: Str 10, Dex 14, Con 14, Int 10, Wis 12, Cha 17. Uses only SRD species, class, subclass, and spell options.

Eilvyre Astath.meta: AC 15 with Mage Armor • HP 20 • Speed 30 ft. • PB +2 • Spell DC 13 • Spell attack +5
Eilvyre Astath.summary: Example ability scores: Str 8, Dex 14, Con 14, Int 12, Wis 10, Cha 17. Wild Magic was replaced because it is not the SRD Sorcerer subclass.

Githtoxundes Fenwophyl.meta: AC 18 • HP 24 • Speed 30 ft. • PB +2 • Spell DC 13 • Spell attack +5
Githtoxundes Fenwophyl.summary: Example ability scores: Str 14, Dex 10, Con 14, Int 10, Wis 17, Cha 8. Uses the SRD Life Domain and standard Cleric spellcasting.

Noldrack Goldhide.type: Example Level 3 Druid (Circle of the Land)
Noldrack Goldhide.meta: AC 15 • HP 24 • Speed 30 ft. • PB +2 • Spell DC 13 • Spell attack +5
Noldrack Goldhide.summary: Example ability scores: Str 12, Dex 14, Con 14, Int 10, Wis 17, Cha 8. Uses the SRD Circle of the Land subclass.

Gunnus.meta: AC 15 with Mage Armor • HP 32 • Speed 30 ft. • PB +3 • Spell DC 14 • Spell attack +6
Gunnus.summary: Example ability scores: Str 8, Dex 14, Con 14, Int 18, Wis 12, Cha 10. Necromancer was replaced because Evoker is the SRD Wizard subclass; Animate Dead remains available as a Wizard spell.

Monk.type: Example Level 5 Monk (Warrior of the Open Hand)
Monk.meta: AC 16 • HP 38 • Speed 40 ft. • PB +3 • Focus Points 5 • Focus DC 14
Monk.summary: Example ability scores: Str 10, Dex 18, Con 14, Int 8, Wis 16, Cha 10. Uses Focus Points and SRD 5.2.1 Monk terminology.

Falling Net.meta: Notice DC 15 • Disable DC 15 • Dexterity save DC 13
Falling Net.summary: On a failed save, the creature is Restrained under the net. It or an adjacent creature can use an action to make a DC 10 Strength (Athletics) check to free it.

Acid Pit.meta: Notice DC 15 • Dexterity save DC 13 • Escape DC 12
Acid Pit.summary: On a failed save, fall 10 feet, taking 1d6 bludgeoning plus 2d6 acid damage. A creature that remains in the acid takes 1d6 acid damage at the start of its turn.

Poison Darts.meta: Notice DC 15 • Disable DC 15 • Dexterity save DC 15
Poison Darts.summary: On a failed save, take 1d4 piercing damage and make a DC 13 Constitution save, taking 2d10 poison damage on a failure or half on a success.

Poison-Spiked Pit.summary: On a failed save, take 2d6 bludgeoning and 1d10 piercing damage, then make a DC 13 Constitution save against 2d6 poison damage, half on a success.

Green Slime.summary: Use the Green Slime hazard rules in SRD 5.2.1. The slime clings to creatures and objects, deals acid damage, and can be removed or destroyed by the methods listed there.

Collapsing Roof.summary: On a failed save, take 4d10 bludgeoning damage; on a success, take half. The collapsed area becomes Difficult Terrain until cleared.

Locking Pit.meta: Notice DC 15 • Dexterity save DC 13 • Lid DC 15
Locking Pit.summary: On a failed save, fall 20 feet and take 2d6 bludgeoning damage. The lid locks; open it with a DC 15 Strength (Athletics) check or DC 15 Dexterity check using Thieves’ Tools.

addtext-06-18-12-20-20-bf18e2677a.rules: Use the Basic Poison entry in SRD 5.2.1.

arrows-0e74583bad.rules: Ammunition for weapons that use arrows; recover expended ammunition as allowed by the SRD.

magical-staff-1ae261f43e.note: Any magical bonus requires a specific SRD magic-item entry or GM-created homebrew.
